record: Austin Historic Landmark Commission staff report and architecture scope
facts: The hotel has clipped original corners, three main gables, pressed brick, limestone and granite. The 1930 tower is reported as 13 storeys, divided into five structural bays with three main high bays extending to the roofline.
The major street facades have raised central gables with the hotel's historic lettering and flanking arched bays.
Survey feature 548940 fixes the roofline plan of the entire hotel and maximum height above its mapped base of 176.048 US survey feet, or 53.6595 m.
